result.summary: The page is largely well-composed: header, search, category chips, promo banner, carousels and bottom nav all render consistently. Two minor visual problems were found: the horizontal category chip row and the restaurant carousel appear to bleed past the right screen edge without any fade/scroll affordance beyond simple clipping, and the third carousel card's title is clipped mid-word at the edge (expected for a carousel, so not counted). Overall no critical or major breakage detected; only minor cosmetic observations.

issues.description: The horizontally scrollable category chip row shows a partially visible chip at the right edge with no visual affordance (fade gradient or peek padding), making it unclear that the row is scrollable.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle right-edge fade gradient or scroll indicator to signal horizontal scrollability of the chip row.

issues.description: In the 'Fastest near you' carousel, card content (delivery fee text '€1.90 delivery') sits very close to the clipped card edge, and the clipped card creates an uneven baseline of text under the row.
issues.suggestion: Ensure consistent card widths and spacing so partially visible cards clip cleanly between cards rather than mid-text where possible.
